Provia 100F datasheet AF3-036E, page index 5, characteristic curves, route stencil-layers; exposure Daylight 1/50 sec; densitometry Fuji FAD-30S (Status A)

Fujifilm Provia 100F datasheet AF3-036E p.6, '21. SPECTRAL DYE DENSITY CURVES'. The chart is embedded as FOUR overlaid 300 dpi 1-bit CCITT stencils: xref 55 = frame/gridlines/labels, xref 56 = yellow, 57 = magenta, 58 = cyan. Each curve is its own isolated single connected component, so no crossing/occlusion disambiguation was required.

CYAN TRUNCATION IS THE DOMINANT SYSTEMATIC. All three curves are drawn to the plot's right edge (~718-719 nm), but cyan is still at 0.587 D there and falling; its true behaviour beyond 719 nm is unpublished. Per the project's no-synthesised-spectra rule the data is set to 0 beyond support rather than extrapolated. Consequence: ISO Status A red responsivity carries 0.020% of its weight beyond 719 nm, which the model therefore treats as CLEAR film. At low dye this is negligible (<=0.01 D for cyan<=2.5), but it is strongly NONLINEAR in cyan amount and creates a spurious hard ceiling on modelled Status A red at -log10(0.0002) = 3.708 D. Bracket on Status A red density (model = lower bound; upper bound = cyan held flat at its 718 nm value): cyan 2.5 -> 0.010 D, 3.0 -> 0.024 D, 3.5 -> 0.059 D, 4.0 -> 0.135 D. Sign is known: physical red reads HIGHER than model. NOTE this also applies to the Velvia 100 dataset (edge 710 nm, cyan 0.291 there; bracket 0.015 D at cyan 3.0, 0.081 D at cyan 4.0) - the earlier 'negligible, 0.00004 D per unit cyan' characterisation of that systematic is only valid at low cyan and understates it in deep shadow.

Peaks Y 442.8 / M 542.6 / C 657.4 differ from Velvia 100 (445.6/553.0/661.7) and Velvia 50 (447.4/544.4/659.6). Provia's secondary absorptions are larger than Velvia 100's (C@450 0.146 vs 0.05-class, M@450 0.205) - consistent with the datasheet's claim that Velvia 100's X/V/S couplers cut 'auxiliary absorptive components'. Do not substitute dye sets across stocks.

Raster-traced (no vector data in this PDF, unlike Velvia 100). Trace-to-ink registration 0-1 px. YELLOW READING FLOOR: yellow unreadable beyond 592 nm (below ~0.013 plot floor, merges with baseline); set to 0 in the data. True value lies in [0, 0.013]; worst case shifts red-channel scan and Status A densities by up to +0.013 D per unit yellow (~0.038 D at yellow amount 3) - physical reads HIGHER than model. This is the largest bounded systematic in this dataset; see README. Peaks Y 447.4 / M 544.4 / C 659.6 nm - distinct from Velvia 100 (445.6/553.0/661.7); larger secondary absorptions than V100 (M@450 0.19 vs 0.05, C@544 0.20 vs 0.10). Do not substitute across stocks.
